# Embedded TSR attribution

The native jscout binary links TSR from https://github.com/ferrotype/tsr at
revision `2009f6ec101358966902698f9ac2a7ff71ed57c3`.

`NOTICE` and `LICENSE` are copied from that revision's `crates/tsr_embed/`.
`licenses/GO-BSD-3-Clause.txt` comes from its root `licenses/` directory.
`TypeScript-CopyrightNotice.txt` comes from `crates/tsr_bundled/bundled/` and
applies to the TypeScript standard-library declarations linked into the binary.
